library.grouping: targets/target.json, MPFB's own slider taxonomy — not re-derived here
library.unitScaleNote: MakeHuman decimetres to metres. The float32 of 0.1, as MPFB stores it.
library.axisOrder: xyz as written in the .target file, which is already glTF Y-up order

notes.detail: 530 files, grouped by target.json into 203 slider categories — 195 bidirectional, 8 unipolar — across 21 regions.
notes.macro: The interpolation corpus for the eight macro.json parameters. NOT 348 sliders.
notes.breast-macro: The corpus for cupsize and firmness, by the same combinatorial rule.
notes.expression: 34 legacy FACS units x 3 ethnicities. Expressions belong to Phase 5, not identity.
notes.asym: 31 randomiser asymmetry pairs, no semantic label. Out of the exposed set; 10.12 handles author-declared asymmetry through the 66 sided detail categories instead.

regions.label: genitals
regions.excludedBecause: Phase 9.8's decency invariant makes them unreachable, so a slider nothing can show would be a lie. research/identity-sculpting.md §2.3.
